staleRule: stale if data/ignition-days.jsonl has a later day than asOfDay; re-run before using the decision

ledger.note: tallies cover every 15%+ intraday mover; per-stock rows the 150 biggest a day

ig8Unbiased.note: IG8 signals from the paper ledger, every signal, stop 8% then the close, fills delayed by minutes, after costs

moversHindsight.note: ONLY stocks that ran 15%+ (hindsight): from the signal minute to the close, no stop, after costs; not a forecast

breakEven.note: live minus 15-minute-delayed fill on the IG8 signals, after costs, times 1,000 USD, times the observed alerts a month; the feed-fixable misses are listed separately because nobody knows what a rule would have earned on stocks it never saw live
breakEven.verdict: FEED DOES NOT PAY ON THE OBSERVED ALERTS

catchable.note: catchable = seen live before +10% (per-stock rows, top 150 a day) plus the feed-fixable data misses (all movers); gap-ups and sub-1-USD stocks are not catchable by any feed

decision.why: blocked is the biggest cause: 489 of 1331 (+36.7%); only 6 valid 5-session outcomes; need 30. Keep current protections; collect more matched outcomes.

caughtInTime.branch4: under 20% caught in time: no sizing

blockedFade5.note: Only dailySample is a 5-session outcome. ledgerSameSessionNegative is same-session and must not be interpreted as a 5-session fade.

actionsLine: Missed runners (6 watched days, 1332 movers of 15%+): VOLUME_FIGURE_LATE 466, UNDER_1_USD 405, NOT_VISIBLE_LIVE 141, AFTER_11_00 99. Decision: BLOCKS_UNRESOLVED.
